organizations.name: Texas Lambda Alpha Nu
organizations.description:
Co-ed Computer Science Fraternity
• Collaborated with CoderDojo to teach kids ages 6-15 how to code using Scratch
• Mentored others within the organization on web development
• Taught workshops at Austin Free Net to increase digital literacy within the community. Workshop topics involved Google's cloud services (Drive, Mail, Calendar) and an Intro to HTML/CSS.
• Volunteered to manage risk at events

organizations.name: Texas Wushu
organizations.description:
As the Treasurer for the 2014-2015 school year:
• Managed club funds, equipment orders, and relationship with UT Recsports
• Arranged lodging and transportation to send competitive team to College Park, MA for the 18th Collegiate Wushu Tournament.
• Collaborated with our main vendor, KungFuDirect, to provide affordable martial arts equipment and apparel for club members.

As the Fundraising Coordinator for the 2014-2015 school year:
• Increased turnout to athletic ushering fundraising events by 50%.

As a member of the competitive team for the 2014-2015 school year:
• Competed in the 19th annual Collegiate Wushu Tournament hosted at University of California Irvine.
• Competed in the 20th annual Collegiate Wushu Tournament hosted at Columbia University.
• Participated in fundraising
